generationParams.prompt:
Create ONE photorealistic furniture consultation rendering of this exact townhouse GREAT ROOM, landscape 3:2. This is an IMAGE EDIT, not a new invented interior.
Reference 1 is the current Mineral & Walnut design and exact camera/finish/layout baseline. Reference 2 is the original model-home architectural ground truth. References 3 onward are actual RH product photographs, used for furniture geometry only.
Preserve the original room envelope, lens, perspective, crown molding, flat ceiling, centered projecting fireplace chase, original gas insert, TWO separate high horizontal transom windows flanking the chase, and left terrace-door glazing. Do not add windows, new ceiling details, niches, rooms, or a grander volume. The room is a modest 15 ft 1 in by 17 ft townhouse great room. Exterior stays Crown neighborhood townhouses/terrace, not countryside. Keep the TV ABOVE the fireplace as in reference 1, not the right-side TV from original reference 2. Keep original quiet mineral fireplace finish; do NOT introduce a new marble fireplace design.
Preserve warm ivory/mushroom softly textured mineral walls, natural matte oak floor, the two fitted low walnut cabinets flanking fireplace, DIFFERENT but sibling neutral abstract art in slim dark frames above BOTH cabinets below the two high windows. Keep full-length ivory sheers on terrace glazing with unobtrusive roller-shade privacy as in reference 1.
FURNITURE PROPOSAL: Replace the foreground sofa with the exact RH Modena Slope Arm 2-Cushion Sofa silhouette in reference 3: two tailored seat cushions, continuous low sloping arms, two back cushions, recessed understated base. Upholstery warm ivory linen-like woven fabric, not stark blue-white. This is a roughly eight-foot sofa, not a sectional. Retain its baseline position facing fireplace.
Replace the TWO lounge chairs with the exact compact RH 1950s Italian Shelter Arm swivel chair silhouette in reference 4: rounded continuous back/shelter arms, waterfall fixed seat, hidden swivel base, no exposed legs. Warm oatmeal/sand woven fabric, modestly deeper tone than sofa. Keep chairs in the same left and right positions but leave their back/side clearance and terrace access open. NOT oversized tub chairs.
Replace coffee table with the RH Gael Walnut Rectangular Coffee Table in reference 5: reproduce its rounded rectangular top, soft edge and sculpted/tapered wooden leg geometry in warm Caramel Walnut. No brass bands, no chrome, no slatted or stone top. Scale as a moderate approximately 50-54 inch planning footprint (visual concept, not a confirmed retail size), not an oversized dining table. Reachable gaps to sofa/chairs.
Reference 6 is RH Gael Walnut Round Side Table: place one modest matching round walnut side table next to foreground right chair, without blocking circulation.
Reference 7 is RH Textura Twist Wool Rug Marled: a large low-profile subtle oatmeal/marled wool rug anchoring sofa and both chairs, use its restrained texture, no blue/pink/purple accents.
Keep one understated ceramic lamp on the right built-in with warm ivory linen shade, a real green tree by the terrace, charcoal/ivory pillows, a small dark tray and a few books. Restrained styling and natural daylight. This should read as a thoughtfully composed warm modern show home, with realistic wool weave, walnut grain and soft upholstery, NOT a generic white showroom. No furniture logos, labels, text, people, pets, duplicated chairs, floating objects, extra sofas or altered architecture.

notes: User confirmed finished long-term room scheme, with purchases in phases.
User previously confirmed RH main pieces with less expensive supporting furniture, soft-but-supportive tidy great-room seating, adult use without regular pets or young children.
RH product pages and collection indexes reviewed; digital sourcebook bookshelf returned 403 and some dynamic product controls were inaccessible. This is not an exhaustive review of every RH SKU.
Generated furniture is illustrative, not a dimensionally exact product model. Catalogue references, physical samples and field measurements govern.
Keep the approved Option 1 mineral fireplace, oak flooring, light sheers/privacy system, sibling art and two fitted walnut cabinets. No Option 2 blue/yellow/chrome scheme.

qaChecks: Two high transoms, centered projecting fireplace chase and left terrace glazing retained.
TV stays above fireplace and both sibling neutral artworks remain.
One tailored sofa, two shelter-arm chairs, walnut coffee table and reachable side table visible.
Natural oak, warm neutral mineral walls and walnut preserved; no Option 2 blue/yellow/chrome palette introduced.
limitations: Furniture is a generative interpretation of RH reference photos, not manufacturer CAD.
The rug and upholstery look more textured in the render than some product photographs; select actual samples before ordering.
Furniture and cabinetry dimensions, circulation and delivery route remain unmeasured; table length is a proposed planning target rather than a confirmed offered SKU.
Lamp is illustrative; the Anja candidate is not represented exactly.
